title: 这不是我的衣服  (Not My Clothes!)

segments.t: Two minutes after going upstairs, Room 4's buzzer rings at the front desk four times in a row. Qing hurries up to find Teacher Song and Chen staring into the open suitcase. Listen first.
宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
Now let's go through each key line together.
宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
'Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!' Two tiny words,
怎么了
give you the quickest natural way to ask 'What's wrong?' or 'What happened?'.
等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
'Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!' Mandarin compares two things by saying 'with yours same', setting both items side by side before declaring them alike.
外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
'The outside is identical, yet look inside!' Teacher Song intensifies 'same' into the four-beat idiom
一模一样
meaning cast from one single mould—completely identical.
两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
'Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.' Things that come in matched pairs—shoes, socks, chopsticks—take
双
as their counting word.
我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
'I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!' Chinese shoe sizes use
码
placed right after the number: 'forty-four size' for standard shoe size 44.
怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
'No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!' When a mystery suddenly makes sense, speakers reach for
怪不得
literally 'cannot blame it for being strange'—'no wonder!'.
火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
'Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!' Putting 'wrong' directly onto 'take' creates
拿错
packing 'took by mistake' into two syllables without needing an extra phrase.
快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
'Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!' Doubling 'look' into
看看
makes the suggestion sound light, casual, and unhurried—'have a quick look'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
我可不穿四十四码的鞋！
怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
火车站有人拿错了我的蓝色行李箱！
您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
Instead of dresses and sheet music, the dark-blue suitcase holds size forty-four men's shoes and a wooden toy train. Let's inspect that luggage tag downstairs next time.
下次见！
